## Evidence appendix — full instance tables, coverage audit, rejections

### Sample A — the 2026-08-20 session (NON-INDEPENDENT: one session, one protocol, one prompt naming the pattern)

| alias | id | status | obligation → the site that missed it |
|---|---|---|---|
| perkish-balsamic-pupfish | `69b9-b740-c53a-4b56` | closed | admin close dispositions as gate evidence; taught `close_precheck.py` (+164) and `transition_close.py` (+29), **never `gates.py`** — sibling plan-review gate left blind |
| irongrey-chubby-oxpecker | `aa7b-5e47-6d3d-4615` | closed | plan asserted `add_comment` returns `{"id": …}`; Cloud/ACLI returns a batch envelope with no id → dedup map permanently empty (~205 comments re-posted/pass) |
| moist-short-lionfish | `958e-f4b3-275c-4154` | closed | self-declared 20 ms write-path budget; `pending_enrichment` (correct at drain time) moved onto the WRITE path |
| electronic-deducible-maggot | `06f4-1c04-83c8-4a9f` | closed | test-distribution assumption changed; tests relying on `xdist_group` not updated |
| ruling-magnific-bats | `10d0-c26c-bdbb-4b1f` | closed | bypassed `add_dependency`'s closed-source guard via `_write_link_event`, and thereby its idempotency check |
| brokendown-moonlit-kiskadee | `0276-7eea-baf0-48e3` | **open** | one verb, two help sources; updated the blob in `_commands/transition.py`, left `_cli/help/transition.txt` (what `--help` renders) |
| itchy-arbored-peccary | `3907-0110-7688-43bd` | closed | ADR 0005 D5 promises "backstopped by the byte total"; no ticket's AC ever obliged it. Plus a second populate path added to a store whose accounting contract existed |
| steep-tired-whimbrel | `f5c4-b2d1-4503-4bfe` | in_progress | fail-open config-unreadable skip written beside gate-off's, collapsing a fault with a policy choice |
| bediasite-bilineate-stoat | `fb8b-189d-97ab-4546` | closed | gate message advertises a remedy colliding with a sibling gate shipped seven weeks earlier |
| conscious-weighable-spittlebug | `3198-438c-72a5-470f` | closed | copy-propagation variant (below) |
| nuclear-calm-heron | `da68-fc7c-068c-4c53` | **open** | drain advisory lock resolves to the WORKTREE `.rebar`; two worktrees hold different locks while draining one store |
| afeard-technical-kodiakbear | `2dc4-9bcd-75b9-4544` | **open** | consolidation follow-up to spittlebug |

**Independently verified against git** (not taken on trust): `9844f6de35` touches
`close_precheck.py`/`transition_close.py` and **no** `gates.py`. `0f999860ad` touches
`_commands/transition.py` and **not** `_cli/help/transition.txt` — while the *earlier* `9844f6de35`
updated **both** help sources, proving the pair was maintained before it drifted. One commit
(`0f999860ad`) produced two of the listed defects.

### Sample B(i) — random sample, n=45 closed bugs (seed 20260820), classifier blind to Sample A

**16 of 45 fit (35.6%); 28 did not; 1 unclassifiable. 13 of the 16 (81%) cross-file.**

| alias | obligation | discharged at | missed at |
|---|---|---|---|
| chanceful-microbial-fallowdeer | terminal-blocker status vocabulary | `_unblock.py`, `_graph.py` (`closed,deleted`), `next_batch.py` | `_ready.py` — `closed` only; `ready` and `next-batch` disagree |
| said-stilt-brow | "any mutating mode is gated" under `REBAR_MCP_READONLY` | the `"live"` string check | other non-zero-cap `MODE_CAPS` modes mutate real Jira |
| vapoury-attack-lamb | surface a failed tickets push to the caller (bug 2a76) | CLI/sync path | async `Popen(stderr=DEVNULL)`, library `NullHandler`, MCP tool result, reconciler logger |
| asbestos-lithe-kouprey | new `unlink … [relation]` contract | `unlink.txt`, `cli-reference.md`, `user-guide.md` | `overview.txt`, `ticket-model.md`, `event-schema.md` |
| craven-oppressed-galago | migrated `compute_mutations(local_state, …)` | the docstring'd migration in `differ.py` | sole caller `run_differs.py:222` → aged-out key planned as resurrect-CREATE |
| aphidian-unartful-hound | (same contract, recurrence) | ditto | ditto |
| terse-frost-ale | no mutation under `REBAR_MCP_READONLY` | the `recover=True` gate, other read tools | plain `fsck()` / `ticket-fsck.sh:180` deletes a stale `index.lock` |
| handwoven-unthankful-reindeer | case-insensitive project-key comparison | `applier._cross_project_targets` (`.upper()`) | `outbound_differ._compute_outbound_create_mutation` |
| cranial-sulfur-peafowl | parent-first cascade invariant | `open→in_progress` in claim/transition | the `closed→open` edge in `reopen` |
| printed-woeful-queenant | "both stages resolve the same repo root" (asserted in a docstring) | `overlay.py` | `prompts.py::get_prompt` |
| unrational-fusible-godwit | cursor-stall guard (`SilentTruncationError`) | `fetcher._iter_pages` | three `acli_graph.py` whole-project readers |
| enhanced-panoramic-armedcrab | inward/outward → relation direction mapping | outbound write path | `_diff_links_inbound` + `_diff_link_removals` |
| autumnal-defectible-xeme | tolerate empty/absent date bounds | git/churn readers | `event_metrics._bounds` → `fromisoformat("")` |
| flap-meal-boast | documented `--opt <value>` space form | composer/write cmds, `_cmd_ready` | `reads_cli.py` `_cmd_session_logs`/`_cmd_list` |
| moldavite-evasive-elephant | assert on signals the invoked route emits | route gating in `__main__.py` | two assertion helpers re-pointed at `sync` |
| shockproof-twill-porpoise | host-independence fixture control | sibling `test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable` | `test_full_backend_account_is_present` |

**Clear non-fits (bucket B), as counter-evidence:** `fond-ulna-ball` (reducer cache key is
`name:size`; a same-size in-place rewrite serves stale state — one wrong key composition, no second
site); `teenyweeny-courteous-goldeneye` (review-bot has no open-status filter → votes on abandoned
changes → 409 → no dedup row → infinite re-selection; the obligation was never conceived anywhere);
`caressive-noteworthy-goldfish` (`_parse_pins` doesn't PEP 503-normalize, so `jaraco.classes` ≠
`jaraco-classes` — both sides inside one helper); `tapestried-abhorrent-tuna` and
`lukewarm-guidable-mantid` (bad test oracles: aggregate wall-clock as a functional assertion;
`int('')` on unchecked subprocess output).

### Sample B(ii) — targeted hunt (~200 titles triaged, 41 read in full, **26 verified**, 15 rejected)

Spanning **2026-07-08 → 2026-08-19**, via unrelated discovery channels (live CI lanes, Gerrit review,
scheduled DC rehearsals, parity audits, extraction slices, operator escalations). Selection:

| alias | id | obligation → missed site |
|---|---|---|
| scratchy-leprous-galago | `1128-505b-54ac-497f` | signed 2026-08-18 write-surface parity ruling; lib+CLI carry `reason`/`caused_by`/`ref`/`force`, handwritten `_mcp_writes.py` forwards only `close_class`/`assignee` (FastMCP drops undeclared keys) |
| airy-starchy-muntjac | `88b9-c847-3a2e-4c63` | relation-scoped `unlink` on CLI+lib; MCP `unlink_tickets` explicitly left outside the change scope |
| biomedical-upper-tench | `8a31-e1c3-cf31-4239` | `error_envelope` discriminator on 10 enumerated CLI emitters; MCP failures arrive as prose |
| earthbound-unexpected-cicada | `8efe-9ceb-7d89-4a33` | canonical JSON schemas generated + CI `--check` for `types.py`; `_mcp_models` hand-mirrored, `BridgeFsckOut` omits `binding_drift`; a comment claiming tests pin it is false (`rg` → 0 hits) |
| vampiric-dollfaced-aurochs | `599e-77da-29dd-482d` | stated invariant "a newly declared extra cannot ship with ZERO CI"; `reviewbot` absent from the isolation set → every review-bot + opcert test (incl. security guards) permanently SKIPPED |
| effective-cleansable-gull | `d343-47c6-5987-43e4` | `applies_to` honoured by plan-review (`orchestrator.py:302-306`); code-review dispatch never reads it → stored, retrievable, **inert** |
| bionic-viewable-macaque | `18a4-9df8-6373-4d9f` | paginator stall guard in `fetcher._iter_pages` + Cloud `acli_graph`; DC `_paged_search` only exits on `if not batch` |
| proficient-voluminous-sandpiper | `0fad-59f7-1605-4377` | multi-page tests + AST anti-regression guard; **the guard scans DC transport source only**, Cloud readers never tested past page 1 |
| defiant-orthoclase-buck | `055d-f176-8fcb-4ffe` | `--force=<reason>` must reach durable storage; `txn.transition_core` declares the param and never reads it |
| common-witting-pondskater | `d064-1660-c088-4a75` | deprecation registry `behavior` field honoured by env/cfg paths; `raise_or_warn_file` has **zero callers** |
| triumphant-feline-drongo | `c9c6-a713-8bc6-4088` | `acli_cmd` honoured by `_verify_created_issue`; `update_priority` declares and never reads it |
| cardinal-secluded-avocet | `02cd-6c10-4ecf-49d6` | `REBAR_LLM_TIMEOUT` defined/documented/env-resolved; never passed to `llm/runner.py` — every call rode the SDK default |
| clingy-kinetic-argusfish | `03b0-2290-f4f3-47a8` | Bedrock ids carry a colon; `_resolve_target`'s "already provider-qualified" test is `":" in model` → drops the configured provider for every `…-v1:0` id |
| frangible-applicable-snipe | `08c8-b6b2-4da6-4373` | deleted-source recovery routes through `rebuild_with_restore`; `_repair_ticket` still calls `rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log` directly |
| carnelian-planetary-silverfox | `b886-3c99-694b-4f91` | `CHECKBOX_NOTE` docstring says "**every** material-staleness reason"; the PRIMARY named-delta branch omits it |
| sulfuryl-suicidal-osprey | `573a-c8c2-ce2b-4b7f` | quarantine-and-retry recovery in `_store/sync.py`; `push_recovery._recover_dirty_merge` gives up with `merge --abort` (filed explicitly as "Parity sibling") |
| ulcerative-confined-blacklemur | `9c7c-4844-f53c-4eac` | `CriterionBank.upsert` gained kw-only args; 3 production call sites updated, the test monkeypatch stub kept the old signature → TypeError on the bedrock arm |
| citric-preregal-ladybird | `751a-6a5c-1e08-46b3` | removing `rebar.llm.review_ticket` obliged retargeting 19 referencing test files; the 2 in `tests/external/` (**excluded from the `Verified` gate**) broke 4 live CI lanes |
| moldavite-evasive-elephant | `9590-34f5-21a8-41fc` | `c87afedba8` deliberately suppressed the `OK:` line; 2 live-DC cells still assert it — again gate-invisible |
| runty-effectible-bluewhale | `9918-a5d6-8fb5-42e8` | resolve code root from repo context, not `dirname(tracker)`; fixed in `close_precheck.py` 4 days earlier under `tekite-fleece-hake`, left standing in `commit_impact.code_root_for` |
| obsolete-lax-siamang | `3b87-66ed-9c0f-4d73` | cef7 tri-state `bridge_project` (`None` vs `""`); `projects_store.resolve_project`'s `if not value` collapses them |
| smalltime-rapid-elk | `8384-f31f-f16f-4f14` | documented dedup contract; `alert_store.is_deduped` reads `timestamp_ns`, neither the record builder nor `append` ever writes it → `ts=0`, suppression can never fire |
| lightsome-sulky-iguanodon | `0c49-c8c9-757f-426d` | `--ref` + close-precheck semantics documented in `transition.txt`; `AGENTS.md:235-242` still describes the pre-change contract |
| captious-hennish-mangabey | `02c4-4e64-5ee3-459c` | RP-02 moved the tombstone cluster to `binding_lifecycle.py`; an integration test still patches `binding_store_mod._now_iso` — passes, but silently lost its blast radius |

Plus `accepted-androgenic-elk` (`0024-fa99-d5bb-49bc`): `_metric_invoke` omitted scc `--by-file` while
`_scc_files` parsed per-file entries; the sibling consumer `metrics/analyzers/scc_loc.py` had already
been fixed under `rapid-cuboid-velvetcrab`, grounding left unaudited.

**Rejections (15 of 41)** — as important as the hits. `kaolinite-head-wildebeest` (`3939-d68c`): looked
perfect ("`judge_one` lacks the bounds `judge_batch` got", $132 quantified) but closed **not_a_bug** —
production flows only through `judge_batch`; `judge_one` is test-only. `sudsy-unquieting-waxwing`
(`4073-9d4f`): the `ast.Attribute` branch has existed since the gate's first commit (`6739ea54fa`),
proven by `git log -S`; the real defect was only missing test evidence. `frangible-irongray-adouri`
(`08c8-2236`): packaging premise disproved character-for-character; actual cause was a host-local
hourly updater `rm -rf`-ing a release dir under a running editable install. Also rejected:
`abdominal-grieving-nandu`, `saintly-letterhigh-yaffle`, `rebel-vaporous-martin`,
`detectible-undiseased-swordfish`.

### The copy-propagation variant (4 instances) — a DIFFERENT mechanism

| alias | id | what propagated |
|---|---|---|
| conscious-weighable-spittlebug | `3198-438c-72a5-470f` | missing `cwd=` on detached spawns: `57114212cf` (2026-06-12, `push.py`) → `9ad46965bd` (`enrich_drain.py`) → `d2dea317ec` (`compact_trigger.py`); all three fixed in `d575600381` |
| malevolent-emigratory-umbrette | `3a33-61e8-6e62-49a7` | an unlocked `git rm` + whole-index commit prune, "near-identical copy-paste" across 4 sidecars, bypassing `event_append.stage_and_commit` |
| chanceful-microbial-fallowdeer | `e63c-d987-6b99-4b56` | one terminal-state set copied into 4 drifted memberships, incl. phantom `done`/`completed` values absent from the status vocabulary |
| unrelative-inbred-piglet | `2bc7-d77b-641c-42aa` | a `_load_module` helper shared verbatim by 3 test files, producing two live `Mutation` classes |

Verified structurally: all three spawn sites lacked `cwd=` at `enrich_drain.py:319`, `push.py:209`,
`compact_trigger.py:206`, and `d575600381` touches exactly those three plus a new `_proc.py`.
**Why this defeats a producer-side criterion:** there was no contract change to trigger one, and the
reviewers of copies 2 and 3 had the strongest available correctness signal — the code matched existing,
shipped, working code. `/rebar-debug` Phase 2 Step 5's prior-art trust check
(`examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md:666-670`) only excludes code *"under an open bug or a
recent CI/test failure"*; `push.py` was under neither, so even that check would have passed.

### Coverage audit — what was enumerated and why each near-miss misses

49 plan-review criteria (`registry.load_criteria()`) and 14 code-review overlays
(`llm/code_review/registry.py`).

| mechanism | posture | why it misses this class |
|---|---|---|
| `omits_required_site` (grade) | **blocking**, 0.85 floor, HARD-OVERRIDE auto-high | a **grading axis**, not a hunter — it can only grade a finding another criterion produced |
| `T13` behavioral-prohibition consumer scan | advisory | triage (MIGRATED/EXEMPTED/**UNCOVERED**) + grep-reducibility fail-open is exactly right, but it triggers only on a **new prohibition**; every instance here is an **addition** |
| `code-review-deletion-impact` | **blocking@0.60**, content-triggered | the **subtractive** mirror (removed/renamed → dangling refs). No additive counterpart exists |
| `code-review-surface-parity` | **advisory, `blocking_enabled: false`**, globs `**/_commands/**`, `**/_lib_writes.py`, `**/_mcp_writes.py` | sibling set is a hardcoded triple; none of the actual missed siblings is one of the three |
| `project.symbol-reference-completeness` | advisory | requires a *named symbol* with an enumerated call-site list. `gates.py`, a help `.txt`, a latency budget, `xdist_group`, an ADR promise are not symbol references |
| `asserted-capability` | advisory | covers the **consumer-side** direction ("does module M provide C?"). The **producer-side** direction has no criterion |
| `G7` leaf-parent containment | blocking | leaf-vs-parent scope, not code siblings |
| `T12(c)` deploy ordering | advisory | producer/consumer *deploy order*, not site completeness |
| `project.portability` | **blocking@0.9** | breakage in an alternate client shape, not "did you update the other shape" |

**Empirical trigger check** (`registry.glob_triggered_overlays`): `surface-parity` glob-fires on
`9844f6de35`, `0f999860ad` and `d575600381` **today** and still would not flag them — the overlay fires
and is scoped out. It also shipped **2026-08-19**, after every Sample-A origin commit (`57114212cf`
2026-06-12, `9ad46965bd` 2026-07-09, `f943c7ef58` 2026-07-13, `746c1ba2e9` 2026-08-12, `d2dea317ec`
2026-08-13, `27b868ba55` 2026-08-14, `9844f6de35` 2026-08-15), so Sample A cannot indict it.
`T13` and `deletion-impact` both shipped 2026-07-06 and thus DID exist for most origins — they did not
fire because their triggers are *prohibition* and *deletion*.

### The debug-time protocol this would move earlier

`examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md:741-785` (Step 7 Axis 2) — shipped, version-controlled
project guidance, consumed downstream by `rebar-implement/SKILL.md:372-379`'s residual-gap disposition
sweep: **NAME THE RULE** (state the invariant as operation + property, *without naming the fixed
site* — "if you can only state it in terms of the file you fixed, you haven't found the rule yet") →
**CHANNEL CENSUS** over a fixed five-slot checklist (CLI / MCP-or-API / library facade / automated
callers / dual-direction) → **PER-SURFACE PROBE** citing `path:line` or marking **MISSING** →
**DISPOSITION** (fix now under RED→GREEN, or file + link `discovered_from`; "silence is not a
disposition"). Fully specified and proven — and it runs only *after* a bug exists.

### Method notes / limits

- Closed-bug corpus: **704**. Only **65 carry a `caused_by` edge** (<10%), so origin attribution is
  recorded almost exclusively where `/rebar-debug` traced it — the corpus cannot be mined
  exhaustively for "origin change that missed a site", and both samples inherit that bias.
- Sample B(i) was drawn with `random.seed(20260820)` over the 704-row closed-bug list; the classifier
  was given the definition but not Sample A.
- Both independent samples are *investigated* bugs, which favours bucket A (it needs three specific
  nameable things). The A rate in a corpus with weaker RCA records would likely be lower.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

Evidence + proposal, no code: does a defect pattern from one 2026-08-20 session generalise, and should
review grow a criterion? **The question turns out to be already asked, measured and documented in-repo —
and only partly acted on.** That, not the pattern, is the finding. The first comment holds the instance
tables, the per-criterion audit, the rejections, and source quotes.

## The pattern (falsifiable)

> **Additive obligation miss.** A change creates a new obligation (contract, invariant, schema field,
> config key, changed default, new evidence kind, or a second site that must stay in step) and
> discharges it at some sites that owe it but not all. The missed site is where the defect surfaces.

All three must be nameable: (1) the obligation; (2) the site(s) that DID discharge it; (3) the site that
did NOT. **Falsifier:** if no site ever discharged it, that is a missing guard, not an obligation miss —
clause (2) is what stops the pattern collapsing into "a bug is when code is wrong".

## The prior art that reframes this ticket

`docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md` measured this over **43 bugs closed
`close_class == regression`**. Its Class 3 ("CLI ↔ MCP ↔ import-format surface parity") is exactly this
question and states: **"No criterion enforces entry-point parity."** Its example
`halfwhite-chordal-stonefly` — a `--class` requirement added to the CLI but not to MCP or NDJSON import
— survived **9 prior PASS reviews with ZERO findings**.

It recommended three criteria. **Verified today: `import-integrity` and `ci-gate-compat` appear nowhere
in `src/` or `.rebar/` — never built.** `surface-parity` was built but narrower: glob-triggered on three
hardcoded paths rather than content-triggered; **omits the NDJSON/import surface from its own founding
bug**; and `blocking_enabled: false`. Its subtractive twin `deletion-impact` is content-triggered and
**blocking@0.60** — same architecture, opposite posture.

## Evidence

**Sample A — the 2026-08-20 session: 12 tickets. NOT independent** (one session, one protocol, one
prompt naming the pattern) — hypothesis-generating only.

**Sample B — INDEPENDENT, two disjoint methods.** *(i)* Random sample of 45 closed bugs (seed 20260820),
classifier blind to Sample A → **16 fit**. *(ii)* Targeted hunt: ~200 titles triaged, **41 read in full,
26 verified, 15 rejected**, spanning **2026-07-08 → 2026-08-19** across unrelated discovery channels.
**The pattern generalises.** Amplifiers that recur: surface multiplicity; **gate-invisible sites** (two
instances missed *external* test modules because they are excluded from the `Verified` gate); guards
inheriting the omission.

**Copy-propagation is a DIFFERENT mechanism, covered by nothing proposed here.** In
`conscious-weighable-spittlebug` the missing `cwd=` originates in `57114212cf` (2026-06-12), was copied
to `9ad46965bd` and `d2dea317ec`, all three fixed in `d575600381` — an omission **deliberately
imitated**, no contract changed. Here the fix site **is** the cause site with no good→bad transition, a
counter-example to "the fix site is not the cause site".

## Adversarial analysis

**Base rate, n=45 random:** A=16 (**35.6%**), B=28 (62.2%), C=1; among A, **81% cross-file**.
**Definition sensitivity is the headline.** Requiring a dated producer commit → **~24%**; loosening to
"two things should have stayed in sync" → **>60%**. The pattern discriminates *only* under the strict
three-clause definition. The targeted hunt rejected 15 of 41 — e.g. `kaolinite-head-wildebeest`, a
perfect-shaped candidate closed **not_a_bug** because the "missed" site is test-only.

**Over-fire warning, from the project's own data** (`docs/plan-review-gate.md:263-269`): across
**18,085** plan-v3 verified findings, the *"omitted scope site / unenumerated consumer"* class had
**1,307** findings, **~90% (1,173) graded `none`**; a blunt widening would have flipped 4.3% of runs
PASS→BLOCK. Strongest argument **against** a broad criterion, and why the proposal is narrow.

**Selection effects (three).** (1) Sample A is one primed session. (2) Only **65 `caused_by` edges
across 704 closed bugs** (<10%) — origin attribution is recorded almost only when `/rebar-debug` traces
it, so corpus-wide measurement is biased. (3) Both independent samples are *investigated* bugs,
favouring the bucket needing three nameable things.

**Sample A cannot indict today's stack.** `surface-parity` shipped **2026-08-19**; every Sample-A origin
commit predates it (2026-06-12 → 2026-08-15). Via `registry.glob_triggered_overlays` it glob-fires on
`9844f6de35`, `0f999860ad`, `d575600381` today and **still** misses all three — its prompt confines
siblings to the lib/CLI/MCP triple, while the real missed siblings were `gates.py`, a help `.txt`, and
three spawn sites. The case rests on Sample B, not Sample A.

**Actionability: solved.** `deletion-impact`/`surface-parity` already give reviewers repo read tools with
a one-hop sweep — trigger scope and posture, not discoverability, are the constraints.
**Portability: clean** — criteria are LLM overlays in `.rebar/criteria_routing.json`; no CI involved.

## Does an existing criterion cover it? Partly

All 49 plan criteria and 14 code-review overlays enumerated; detail in the comment.
`omits_required_site` is blocking but a **grade**, not a hunter. `T13` runs the right enumeration but
triggers only on **prohibitions**, while every instance here is an **addition**. `deletion-impact` is
the **subtractive** mirror. `/rebar-debug` Step 7 Axis-2 has the full census but runs **only at debug
time**. **Residual gap:** *no criterion asks "this change adds an obligation — enumerate every surface
that owes it and dispose of each."*

## Proposal

A broad "update every consumer" criterion is **not** warranted (~90% immateriality). By cost-to-value:

- **P0 — close the three documented gap-analysis recommendations, or record why not.** Two never built;
  the third shipped narrower. Cheapest real progress; no new research needed.
- **P1 — widen `surface-parity` to what was recommended:** content-triggered, channel list extended to
  the NDJSON/import surface, plus a calibration run to decide blocking on `deletion-impact`'s precedent.
- **P2 — widen `T13`'s trigger lexicon from *prohibition* to *obligation*.** A prompt edit.
- **P3 (only if residue remains) — project overlay `project.obligation-parity`**, the additive mirror of
  `deletion-impact`, importing Step 7 Axis-2's census; triage MIGRATED/EXEMPTED/**UNCOVERED**; abstain
  when the obligation is not reducible to a checkable pattern. Anti-fire threshold mirroring
  `project.portability`: a finding needs (a) the cited added line, (b) `path:line` of a site that DID
  discharge it in the same diff, (c) `path:line` of one that did NOT, (d) the observable consequence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A ruling on P0-P3 — adopt / adopt-narrowed / reject — with reasons.
- [ ] `import-integrity` / `ci-gate-compat`: built, or the decision not to written into
      `docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md` so it stops reading as three open recs.
- [ ] Any criterion promoted to blocking has a calibration replay vs `deletion-impact`'s precedent and
      the ~90%-`none` omitted-scope-site rate.
- [ ] Any adopted prompt encodes all four evidence elements (a)-(d); one lacking any is rejected.
- [ ] Replayed against >=5 origin commits named here (`9844f6de35`, `0f999860ad`, `27b868ba55`,
